shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; cat specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; rg -n 'beforeSession|afterSession|onError' src/orchestration/*test*; cat package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; sed -n '235,365p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; cat src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts; ls scripts/spec-links; rg -n 'specs/hal-engine-config-hooks|spec anchor|spec:' src/orchestration/*.test.ts | head -60; sed -n '1,90p' CHANGELOG.md; ls node_modules/.bin/jest node_modules/.bin/prettier"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/["'^ ]+#|@spec|spec:'"' src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -80; rg -n 'specs/.*#|VALIDATED_BY|specAnchor' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs scripts/check-spec-links.mjs; rg -n 'reanchor' scripts; git branch --show-current"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; rg -n 'specs/.+#[0-9]|@spec|spec-anchor|specId' src scripts .lore --glob '*.ts' --glob '*.mjs' --glob '*.yml' | head -80; ls scripts | rg 'spec|anchor'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.failure.test.ts | head -25; nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '36,42p'; nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts | sed -n '140,165p'; git diff --stat; git diff -- .lore/dod.md scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.failure.test.ts && git commit -m "Run failure hooks when beforeSession throws"'
